news.title: FIFA U15 World Cup Requires More Attention, Says Grassroots Sport Forum President Godwin Bamigboye
news.lede: The president of Nigerian Grassroots Sport Development Forum (NGSDF), Godwin Bamigboye has charged the country’s decision makers in football to give better attention to preparations for the forthcoming FIFA U-15 World Cup. Sports247 reports that, with the cadet championship and festival scheduled to hold in Azerbaijan from the 24th to 30th of next month, Bamigboye is worried that Nigeria has not set preparations in motion; and warned that such levity could adversely affect the country’s team. Bamigboye went on to urge top shots at Nigeria Football Federation (NFF) and National Sports Commission (NSC) to immediately commence full fledged action, in order to ensure the country’s team, Baby Eagles, get a good outing in the championship.
